rationale: Retain the tested current cap after cohort-specific pilots: all four validation Dice scores exceed71%, training stays73–80%, gaps0.55–3.04pp, late validation improves with training and final scores stay close to best. No evidence warrants increasing compute or cutting to a premature stage. This is a validated conservative working cap, not a proven optimal cap.
selection_scope: One shared cap across SwinUNETR/UNETR,10/20subjects,baseline/originalbands/expandedbands. Selected from baseline-only development pilots before new constrained results.
constraints: Keep recipes,split,seed,augmentation and calibration targets fixed. No epoch-matching multiplier and no model-specific cap.
limitations: Validation used for development diagnostics; no guarantee against overfitting. Existing headroom is a safeguard, and full train/validation curves remain reported.
baseline_reuse: Four pilot baselines exactly match chosen cap/cohorts/recipes. Reuse their verified archives rather than duplicate training. Per-voxel baseline transition comparisons are omitted because prediction volumes were not retained.
